name: ROKA Dubai
questions: Which robata items can be grilled without soy-based glazes?
summary: Accommodating according to London reports, with GF options listed in Dubai. Unconfirmed.
tamari_source: An Intravel listing says the Dubai menu has GF options. London FMGF reviewers say there's no GF menu but trained staff adapt dishes. I found no tamari mention.
